wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap way 892934946 gives the outline of the named six-sided tower at 480 Lakeshore Avenue, matching Wikidata Q5559191 and the City’s standing lighthouse.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the hexagonal taper and open red gallery. Near levels add stone recesses, rail spindles, lantern frames, and metal roof seams.
limitations: Lantern glazing, sill details, exact masonry courses, and opening positions on partly hidden faces are interpreted from the 2011 photograph and documented construction.
The historic 1815 lantern, keeper’s house, surrounding woods, paths, plaques and later park improvements are outside the model.
